release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.7

• **Fixed Lyrics Sync & Animation Glitching**: Fixed active-line key resets that snapped animations, added instant mid-song scroll & two-stage catch-up so lyrics stay locked to playback, upgraded word-by-word karaoke to smooth 60fps interpolation with 50ms position polling, and removed text-reflow/blur jitter.
• **Fixed PC Keyboard Shortcuts & Global Hotkeys**: Fixed stale Search focus trapping shortcuts across tabs/fullscreen, fixed key-rebind capture, added shifted/numpad key aliases (?, +, -) & hold-to-repeat for volume/seek, wired Ctrl+F search focus, Ctrl+L lyrics toggle, V visualizer launch, and native Win32 RegisterHotKey for system-wide media keys.
• **Fixed PC Animation Glitches**: Eliminated full-shell backdrop rebuilds, mouse-hover setState stutter in HoloDeck 3D artwork, and mode-switcher key mismatches in Fullscreen Now Playing.
